system.description:
At 1st level, you exude an aura of command in a 15ft radius. You are considered to be touching allies or enemies within this radius for the purpose of spellcasting. This increases the range of some spells, like @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.qvf5zussamqd1ic1]{Heroism}, to 15ft. This benefit similarly works in reverse, allowing someone to cast @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.1vo427vjnzgzb5z2]{Cure Wounds} on you so long as they are within the aura.

In addition, you may use Reaction spells to the benefit of allies within your aura of command. For example; using the @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.npaw56x028swb7mz]{Arcane Riposte} spell when an ally within 15ft is attacked. If the spell requires you to be within 5ft or melee range of the creature that triggered the ability, a brief illusory double of you appears within 5ft and casts the spell. The illusory double does not benefit from, or grant, flanking bonuses and disappears instantly.
